name: board-game-catalog
description: Private catalog of our board game collection — games, editions, expansions, KS exclusives and accessories.

scripts.predev: node scripts/sync-estate-auth.mjs && node scripts/sync-estate-search.mjs && node scripts/sync-estate-theme.mjs
scripts.predeploy: node scripts/sync-estate-auth.mjs && node scripts/sync-estate-search.mjs && node scripts/sync-estate-theme.mjs && node scripts/check-clean.mjs && node scripts/deploy-guard.mjs && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy --workspace @bgc/worker
scripts.predeploy:games2: node scripts/instance-guard.mjs games2 && node scripts/sync-estate-auth.mjs && node scripts/sync-estate-search.mjs && node scripts/sync-estate-theme.mjs && node scripts/check-clean.mjs && node scripts/deploy-guard.mjs --instance=games2 && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.deploy:games2: npm run build && npm run deploy:games2 --workspace @bgc/worker
scripts.secret:games2: node scripts/instance-guard.mjs games2 && wrangler secret put --config apps/worker/wrangler.toml --env games2
scripts.secret:list:games2: node scripts/instance-guard.mjs games2 && wrangler secret list --config apps/worker/wrangler.toml --env games2
scripts.db:migrate:games2: node scripts/instance-guard.mjs games2 && npm run db:migrate:games2 --workspace @bgc/worker
scripts.pretypecheck: node scripts/sync-estate-auth.mjs && node scripts/sync-estate-search.mjs && node scripts/sync-estate-theme.mjs
scripts.estate:sync: node scripts/sync-estate-auth.mjs && node scripts/sync-estate-search.mjs && node scripts/sync-estate-theme.mjs
scripts.secrets:push:games2: node scripts/instance-guard.mjs games2 && node scripts/push-secrets.mjs --env games2
scripts.pretest: node scripts/sync-estate-auth.mjs && node scripts/sync-estate-search.mjs && node scripts/sync-estate-theme.mjs
scripts.test: tsx --test packages/db/test/*.test.ts apps/worker/src/lib/*.test.ts apps/worker/src/middleware/*.test.ts apps/worker/src/routes/*.test.ts apps/web/test/*.test.ts scripts/test/*.test.mjs
